channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: OpenAI is reported to be racing to close a round valuing it above $1.4 trillion
item.description: Reuters reports OpenAI wants investor commitments quickly, ahead of Anthropic's expected stock market listing.

item.title: Netflix beats forecasts but cuts its ad sales goal, and its shares slide
item.description: Revenue rose 12% to $12.87 billion, yet Netflix lowered its 2026 ad revenue outlook and the stock fell about 6% after hours.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 holds Very Positive Steam reviews ahead of Friday's launch
item.description: Early players have given the campaign a Very Positive rating across more than 3,100 Steam reviews before the October 23 release.

item.title: SpaceX's AI business out-earns Starlink as revenue jumps 161%
item.description: SpaceX made $14.6 billion in the third quarter, with $7.6 billion from AI, and shares rose more than 4% after hours.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources the software that runs its own AI service
item.description: DeepInfer, the inference stack behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, is now free to use under an Apache 2.0 licence.

item.title: Apple moves some iPhone Duo deliveries earlier ahead of Friday's launch
item.description: Some US and Japan buyers of the sold-out $1,999 foldable are seeing delivery estimates pulled forward by weeks.

item.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 posts Tamil cinema's second-biggest opening weekend
item.description: The sequel took Rs 199.9 crore in India in four days and $31.2 million worldwide on the weekend, second only to Street Fighter.

item.title: GTA VI is now one month from its November 19 release
item.description: With a month to go, retailers from Best Buy in the US to Germany's Edeka are lining up GTA VI campaigns.

item.title: Google Cloud outage in London knocks out Revolut and other UK banks
item.description: A 'power event' in Google's London region took down banking apps for hours, with Revolut listing 31 services affected.

item.title: US homeland security orders DeepSeek removed from federal systems
item.description: Federal civilian agencies must remove DeepSeek technology and stop buying its products, the Wall Street Journal reports.

item.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort reviews land, with GameSpot calling it the series' best
item.description: The Switch 2 sports game, set on Wuhu Island, sits at 79 on Metacritic from 46 reviews ahead of its October 22 launch.

item.title: Street Fighter wins the weekend with $31 million and $51 million worldwide
item.description: Street Fighter led the worldwide weekend with $51.2 million and topped the UK chart with £2.3 million.

item.title: Netflix film chief Dan Lin is out after almost three years
item.description: Lin was let go at the start of the weekend, Variety reports, the latest senior exit in a week of Netflix job cuts.

item.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix, with Hideo Kojima in the cast
item.description: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime launched on October 20, and Hideo Kojima returns as Hideyoshi Oshima.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance scores 36/40 from Famitsu ahead of its October 22 launch
item.description: Square Enix's turn-based HD-2D game gets four 9s from the Japanese magazine, with a reported 70 hours to finish everything.

item.title: Canadian news publishers sue Anthropic over training Claude on their articles
item.description: Postmedia, Torstar, The Globe and Mail and The Canadian Press allege copyright infringement in an Ontario court.

item.title: Salesforce agrees to buy marketing platform Braze for about $5.7 billion
item.description: The all-cash deal pays $47.50 a share, sending Braze stock up about 50% while Salesforce fell about 2%.

item.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reported to be in talks on a $45 billion compute deal
item.description: Bloomberg reports Nscale is negotiating a second deal with Anthropic for about 460 megawatts of computing from West Virginia.

item.title: One hacker used AI agents to breach more than 100 company websites, Reuters reports
item.description: A Chinese-speaking hacker handed much of the work to AI agents, with a campaign that reportedly cost a few thousand dollars.

item.title: Character actor Richard Riehle, Office Space's Tom Smykowski, dies at 78
item.description: Riehle, who worked on more than 400 projects over nearly five decades, died of natural causes in Los Angeles.

item.title: ID@Xbox showcase reveals A Game About Digging A Hole Together and Mouthwashing date
item.description: Microsoft's indie showcase with IGN set dates for more than a dozen games, from Shrek 2 Remastered to Croak.

item.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million without giving up any shares
item.description: The meeting transcription company took non-dilutive money from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund and says it passed $100M ARR.

item.title: Nathan Fielder's Holmes film opens to $15 million, a documentary near-record
item.description: A24's You Can See Everything took about $15 million from just 855 theaters, the second-best non-fiction opening ever.

item.title: People are using AI coding tools to strip ads from their smart TVs
item.description: Developers are using Claude Code and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to remove ads and tracking from Fire TV and Google TV devices.

item.title: Eka raises $150 million for a robot model that uses touch as well as sight
item.description: The robotics startup is valued at $1.45 billion after a Series A led by a16z and F-Prime.

item.title: Steam Next Fest opens with a record 8,000-plus free demos
item.description: Valve's October demo festival lists more than 8,000 demos, about double June's event, with ArcheAge Chronicles leading early play.

item.title: Amazon pledges more than €16 billion for Germany in 2027
item.description: The plan covers AWS and AI data centers, the Leo satellite program, Prime Video productions and a Berlin robotics lab.

item.title: Inception launches Mercury 3, a diffusion model it says tops 1,000 tokens a second
item.description: The startup claims its new model beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on agent tests while running 4x to 8x faster.

item.title: Resident Evil holds No. 1 in China and passes $361 million worldwide
item.description: The film led China's box office for a second weekend with $9.3 million, as the country's yearly takings run 29% behind 2025.

item.title: LittleBigPlanet gets a fan-made PC port reportedly built with an AI model
item.description: The PS3 game joins Astro Bot and God of War III as PlayStation titles brought to PC through AI-assisted efforts, per Instant Gaming.

item.title: Apple commits up to $100 million to a US titanium supplier for the iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple will invest in Pennsylvania's Perryman Company over three years and says nearly 100 iPhone parts are now US-made.

item.title: Microsoft adds tools to rein in risky AI agents at work
item.description: New controls in Microsoft 365 E7 and Project Perception rate each agent for risk and let admins block or shut it down.

item.title: Depositions say TikTok executives ignored warnings about child exploitation on Live
item.description: NPR reports staff told executives that minors were appearing in livestreams where exploitation took place.

item.title: Disney agrees to hire most of Character.AI's workforce
item.description: Disney will take on the majority of staff at Character.AI, the chatbot company that filed for bankruptcy this month.

item.title: Meta details Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale AI supercluster in Ohio
item.description: Meta's engineers say the New Albany site links hundreds of thousands of GPUs, aiming for about a million to train Muse models.

item.title: Taylor Swift's The Life of a Showgirl spends a 15th week at No. 1
item.description: Swift's album leads the Billboard 200 again, ahead of Olivia Rodrigo, Morgan Wallen, Ella Langley and Noah Kahan.

item.title: AI-made clone games are pushing indie developers to hide their demos
item.description: PC Gamer reports quick AI-built copies of new indie hits, with one studio cancelling its Steam demo for fear of clones.

item.title: US blacklists Chinese investor MiraclePlus over a Google AI secrets case
item.description: MiraclePlus, often called China's Y Combinator, funded a startup founded by a man convicted of stealing Google's AI trade secrets.

item.title: Benny Safdie's Lizard Music adds Colman Domingo, Jeff Goldblum and Rachel McAdams
item.description: A24 has set the Daniel Pinkwater adaptation, starring Dwayne Johnson, for Christmas Day 2027.

item.title: Nintendo says it underestimated demand for its Zelda Switch 2 console
item.description: A Nintendo executive apologised for shortages of the Zelda 40th Anniversary console and promised restocks, without a date.

item.title: Burger King Japan discloses a breach of 11.18 million customer records
item.description: Names, birth dates, contact details and order histories, mostly from app users, were exposed in early October.

item.title: Funcom lays off staff after Dune: Awakening's console launch
item.description: The studio is restructuring as the survival game shifts to a games-as-a-service model, a month after reaching PS5 and Xbox.

item.title: Tamil film composer Deva dies at 75
item.description: The composer and singer, who scored more than 400 films and pioneered gaana music in cinema, died in Chennai.
